growth.name: Growth
growth.purpose: Track maturity, adoption, telemetry, deprecation, and learning signals so artifacts evolve deliberately instead of becoming undocumented leftovers.

roles.use: New concept, early pattern, or experiment.
Shared artifact with documented examples and adoption.
Artifact with telemetry, quality signals, and known outcomes.
Artifact replaced or unsafe for new work.
Behavioral audit for critical actions and adoption.

productExamples.example: Actions expose data-growth-stage and analytics event metadata.
New KPI starts seed, becomes measured after adoption and threshold validation.
Fleet dashboard suite tracks whether patterns reduce support or improve task completion.
Deprecated card action is visible in docs with replacement path and cutoff rule.

agentInstructions: Declare maturity and measurement expectation for new shared artifacts.
Add deprecation guidance when replacing an artifact.
Tie telemetry to product decision, not vanity metrics.
rejectIf: Docs claim done without examples, states, and validation.
